narrative: On the board. A second sentence under the first. The hand pauses before the verse. On the board. The verse stands alone, with a space under it. The spelling is as written. Nothing is struck through. On the board. Blank paper under the verse. The pen is lifted. The pile at the left is still face down and still unopened.
